title: Customer Survey
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael pretends to be engaged, leading to disbelief from his mother. Kelly returns her bridesmaid dress and is revealed to be responsible for contacting clients for customer service feedback. Dwight receives poor customer feedback and suspects sabotage, eventually accusing Kelly of manipulating survey results. Jim and Pam communicate secretly and express affection. Michael takes over a sales call from Dwight and successfully closes a million-dollar deal. Andy and Angela negotiate wedding tent preferences and agree to use Schrute Farms as their wedding venue. Michael announces intensive sales retraining for Jim and Dwight, while Dwight exhibits paranoid behavior regarding customer feedback and local politics.
